citation.authors: Sharma AK, Basu I, Singh S
citation.journal: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: stress, sleep, thyroid and liver cautions

record.population: Adults aged 18 to 50 with subclinical hypothyroidism (raised TSH), one hospital in Varanasi, India
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of ashwagandha root extract 600 mg a day for 8 weeks
record.finding: TSH, T3 and T4 improved compared with placebo over 8 weeks. Four people withdrew (two from each group).
record.note: A small pilot at one site. NCCIH still advises people with thyroid disorders not to use ashwagandha, so this does not settle it; the two sources disagree in tone.
